Class PersistenceManager

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingws.gc8.Persistence.PersistenceManager
public class PersistenceManager extends Object
FA2 — saves and restores match snapshots on disk using plain Java serialization (no JSON, no extra dependencies; consistent with the TCP transport).

One file per match (<id>.snapshot) plus a one-deep rotation (<id>.snapshot.bak). Writes are crash-safe: the snapshot is written to a temporary file and then atomically renamed onto the final path, so a crash mid-write never corrupts the live snapshot.

The save directory is configurable via the MESOS_SAVE_DIR environment variable, defaulting to ./mesos-saves.

  • Method Details

    • fromEnvironment

      public static PersistenceManager fromEnvironment()
      Returns:
      a manager rooted at MESOS_SAVE_DIR or ./mesos-saves.

    • save

      public void save(MatchSnapshot snapshot) throws IOException
      Persists a snapshot atomically: write-to-temp then atomic rename, keeping the previous snapshot as a .bak. Synchronized per manager so two saves of the same match cannot interleave their temp/rename steps.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the snapshot to write
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing or renaming fails

    • toBytes

      public static byte[] toBytes(MatchSnapshot snapshot) throws IOException
      FA2: serializes a snapshot to a byte array. Callers serialize the model graph while holding the game lock (so it is consistent), then hand the resulting bytes to saveBytes(String, byte[]) for the slow disk write off the lock.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the snapshot to serialize
      Returns:
      the serialized bytes
      Throws:
      IOException - if serialization fails

    • saveBytes

      public void saveBytes(String matchId, byte[] data) throws IOException
      Persists already-serialized snapshot bytes atomically: write-to-temp then atomic rename, keeping the previous snapshot as a .bak. Synchronized per manager so two saves of the same match cannot interleave.
      Parameters:
      matchId - the match whose snapshot is being written
      data - the serialized MatchSnapshot bytes
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing or renaming fails

    • loadAll

      public List<MatchSnapshot> loadAll()
      Loads every valid snapshot found in the save directory. Corrupt or unreadable files are skipped with a warning rather than aborting startup.
      Returns:
      all successfully deserialized snapshots
